purpose:
Independent C2-C development review of frozen raw logs and first audit.

Do not execute before root authorizes the completed formal raw/audit paths.
Standard library only: no project imports, simulator, predictions, RLS replay,
fitting, held-out reads or new interactions. Recompute residual metrics from
recorded predictions, calibration/control input coverage, actual effort,
stops/budgets/update counts and the two frozen adoption gates. Preserve all
audited multi-step/risk details, exact source bytes, input hashes and timing.

formal_collection_timing.cpu_seconds_scope: Current process only; same timer-start/checkpoint scope as wall_seconds; excludes imports, initial source snapshot and setup before timers

coverage_gate.trajectory_semantics: Paired calibration support on short/reordered control inputs; nominal is descriptive only.

audited_adoption_gate.claim_boundary: Development timing choice only; not safety, causal position-only benefit, or unseen generalization.

audited_rollout_semantics: Recorded future requests are offline conditional inputs. Only initial native q/v; no future-state feedback. Windows cannot cross reset, phase, missing, partial, study or environment stop. Full terminal endpoints counted separately. Final-model calibration is in-sample; overlapping windows are not independent samples.
comparison_semantics: Raw per-seed means; paired calibration supports on each same physical control input; different controller trajectories are separate closed-loop effects. No pooling overlapping windows, picked blocks or seed-wise controller choices.
coverage_semantics: Complete active native inputs; strict q/v envelope exclusion, equality inside; nearest q-only distance. Coverage gate does not establish prediction accuracy or safety.
risk_semantics: Full audited per-seed/full/phase raw risk retained; missing substep peaks/impulse/penetration are lower bounds, minimum contact distance upper bound, native joint speed/limits endpoints only; zero stops do not prove safety.

execution.timing_scope: review entry through source bytes/input unchanged validation and report assembly; excludes imports and JSON serialization/writing
